scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n core,cli,dashboard,supervisor -c cyan,magenta,green,yellow "pnpm -C packages/core dev" "pnpm -C packages/cli dev" "pnpm -C packages/dashboard dev" "node --watch packages/cli/dist/index.js supervisor"
scripts.docker-up: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n supervisor,dashboard -c yellow,green "pnpm supervisor" "pnpm -C packages/dashboard dev --host 0.0.0.0"
scripts.clear: rm -f ~/.tenxgrace/pipeline.sqlite ~/.tenxgrace/pipeline.sqlite-wal ~/.tenxgrace/pipeline.sqlite-shm ~/.tenxgrace/resume.json ~/.10xgrace/pipeline.sqlite ~/.10xgrace/pipeline.sqlite-wal ~/.10xgrace/pipeline.sqlite-shm ~/.10xgrace/resume.json && rm -rf ~/.tenxgrace/sessions ~/.tenxgrace/pr-resolver ~/.tenxgrace/pr-resolver-state.json ~/.10xgrace/sessions && echo '✓ Cleared pipeline DB, session worktrees, and PR-resolver state (current + legacy). Restart pnpm dev.'
